title: Amazing Guided Tour of the Alhambra
text: We had a wonderful experience visiting the Alhambra with our guide. The tour was very well organized, and the guide was knowledgeable, friendly, and passionate about the history of this incredible place. We learned many fascinating details that we would have missed on our own. The architecture, gardens, and views were breathtaking. The guide made the visit enjoyable and engaging for everyone in the group. We highly recommend this guided tour to anyone visiting Granada. It was one of the highlights of our trip!

title: Satisfied with the reservation of the entrance and the arrangements made by the company Viator.
text:
My experience has been satisfactory. I requested a ticket a few days in advance, and after downloading the app, I received the ticket.
 For the Nasrid palaces, it is necessary to reserve a specific hour. They granted me a time, but it did not correspond to my needs, so I requested another hour, and they provided me with a more suitable time.
 I am very happy with the experience regarding the ticket reservation, although the price is high.
Regarding the audio guide, they provided me with an app to download on my phone.

title: To do absolutely
text:
The Alhambra MUST be seen (possibly between late April and early May with the flowering of wisteria and roses, which makes everything magical).
There was no longer any possibility with regular tickets and getting them through Viator allowed us not to miss this incredible experience. Highly recommended!
